trial_court: learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class (2nd Additional Munsiff) Srinagar, CRM(M) No.238/2019
case_name: Showkat Aziz Zargar vs Nabeel Showkat & Another

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Showkat Aziz Zargar — father, seeking cancellation of maintenance order
parties.respondent_defendant: Nabeel Showkat & Another — sons, receiving maintenance

facts_of_case: Respondents' sons moved for maintenance; petitioner sought cancellation of order after respondents attained majority.

legal_principles.principle: A child who has attained majority does not automatically cease to claim maintenance.
legal_principles.held: Any child who has attained majority does not automatically cease to claim maintenance and he/she cannot be allowed to starve.

legal_principles.principle: A child who is unable to maintain himself/herself due to physical or mental abnormality or injury can claim maintenance from his/her father.
legal_principles.held: Thus, irrespective of age of a child i.e., son/daughter, he/she is entitled to claim maintenance from father provided he/she has any physical or mental abnormality or injury on account of which he/she is unable to maintain himself/herself.
keywords: physical or mental abnormality or injury

legal_principles.principle: A major son is entitled to claim maintenance from his father if he is unable to maintain himself due to physical or mental disability.
legal_principles.held: Thus, irrespective of age of a child i.e., son/daughter, he/she is entitled to claim maintenance from father provided he/she has any physical or mental abnormality or injury on account of which he/she is unable to maintain himself/herself.

legal_principles.principle: A major son who is gainfully employed or has attained such qualification so as to maintain himself cannot claim maintenance from his father.
legal_principles.held: Relying upon the judgment in Surjeet Kour's case (supra), a Single Judge of this Court in the case of Tariq Mehmood Bhat vs. Zubaida Akhtar and Ors. has observed that for seeking cancellation of order of maintenance, it has to be shown that the major son is gainfully employed or he has attained such qualification so as to maintain himself.
cited_cases: Tariq Mehmood Bhat vs. Zubaida Akhtar and Ors.
